name: Steal a Car
desc:
🗣️ Welcome to Steal a Car!

👍 Like the game and join the group

How to Play:
🚘 Buy cars to earn cash
🕵️ Sneak into enemy bases and steal their best cars
💸 Stack your garage and grow your income
🔥 Rebirth for insane bonuses
🧢 Use gear and slaps to troll other players!

💻 Supports Desktop, Mobile, and Tablet players
